scope: gfx1151 Laguna c=1 native selected-down plus event wait plus D9 host batch

candidate.description: Within one native host call, enqueue the retained route-parallel weighted selected-down kernel, wait on the already-existing shared-output event, and enqueue the retained local256 D9 kernel.

directional_gate.decision: continue to seven pairs and trace

decision.reason: The native call did not contract the measured GPU boundary: selected-down to D9 remained 8.376 us per layer and slightly increased in aggregate. The small positive seven-pair median is not attributable to the proposed mechanism and includes one severe candidate outlier.
decision.reopen_only_if: A true model-launch contraction removes a kernel or dependency instead of merely moving already-asynchronous host calls into C.
